image_description: A black and white close-up photograph of a disposable plastic lighter resting on top of a cigarette pack. The lighter features bold, capitalized text reading 'BUY YOUR OWN FUCKING LIGHTER'. The flame guard, spark wheel, and nozzle are visible at the top left. The background shows part of the cigarette packaging with circular design elements.

artifact_observations.reasoning: Partial text 'TTES' and 'SOCS' is visible on the right side of the background pack. While likely real-world packaging abbreviations (e.g., CIGARETTES, BOXES), AI generators often struggle with partial occlusion of text, making this a potential artifact zone, though it looks physically plausible here.

The reflections on the plastic wrapping of the cigarette pack are slightly soft and lack the sharp, chaotic specular highlights typical of crinkled cellophane, suggesting slight smoothing or generation blur.

To check for edge bleeding between the lighter and the cigarette pack, and ensure the plastic casing is a continuous manifold.
To verify the physical contact shadow between the lighter and the pack, ensuring they are not floating.
